async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Add Attribute' button to open the dialog
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Add Attribute").click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for dialog to appear
    
    # In the 'Add Attribute' dialog, filter for 'size' attribute
    # Click the 'Filters' button to open filter options
    await page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Add Attribute").get_by_role("button", name="Filters").click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    
    # Find the textbox for 'Attribute Label' and fill with 'size'
    filter_textbox = page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Add Attribute").get_by_role("textbox").first
    if await filter_textbox.count() > 0:
        await filter_textbox.fill("size")
    
    # Click the 'Apply' button to apply the filter
    apply_button = page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Add Attribute").get_by_role("button").filter(has_text="Apply")
    if await apply_button.count() > 0:
        await apply_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    
    # Select the 'size' attribute if found
    size_row = page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Add Attribute").get_by_role("row").filter(has_text="size")
    if await size_row.count() > 0:
        checkbox = size_row.get_by_role("checkbox")
        await checkbox.check()
    
    # Filter for 'color' attribute
    if await filter_textbox.count() > 0:
        await filter_textbox.fill("color")
    if await apply_button.count() > 0:
        await apply_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    
    # Select the 'color' attribute if found
    color_row = page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Add Attribute").get_by_role("row").filter(has_text="color")
    if await color_row.count() > 0:
        checkbox = color_row.get_by_role("checkbox")
        await checkbox.check()
    
    # Click 'Add Selected' button to add the selected attributes
    add_selected_button = page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Add Attribute").get_by_role("button", name="Add Selected")
    if await add_selected_button.count() > 0:
        await add_selected_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for attributes to be added and dialog to close
    
    # Fill in the main form fields
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="[STORE VIEW] Product Name *").fill("FancyBoy Man Causal Jeans")
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="[GLOBAL] SKU *").fill("FANCYBOY-JEANS-001")
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="[GLOBAL] Price * $").fill("169.99")
    await page.get_by_role("textbox", name="[GLOBAL] Quantity").fill("42")
    
    # Set size attribute to '34' if present in the form
    size_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox").filter(has=page.get_by_text("size", exact=False))
    if await size_combobox.count() > 0:
        await size_combobox.select_option("34")
    
    # Set color attribute to 'Blue' if present in the form
    color_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox").filter(has=page.get_by_text("color", exact=False))
    if await color_combobox.count() > 0:
        await color_combobox.select_option("Blue")
    
    # Click the 'Save' button
    await page.get_by_role("button", name="Save").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
